description.en: Dormilux traditional pillow is suitable for sleeping on the side and on the back. Conforming contour, biomechanical support, pleasant feeling, high air circulation, optimal position in the neck and shoulder area. The soft core of the pillow is filled with ground memory foam. Provides the highest degree of breathing activity and heat regulation.

Obezbeđuje najviši stepen disajne aktivnosti i regulaciju toplote.

alt.en: Memory Pillow - Anatomical pillow for neck and shoulder pain relief
alt.sr: Memory jastuk - Anatomski jastuk za ublažavanje bolova u vratu i ramenima

description.en: The main causes of pain in the shoulders, neck and head are poor position and pressure in the cervical spine. The pillow is the key to proper sleeping position. Its choice is of utmost importance. The anatomical pillow, in addition to providing support to the cervical spine, does not press on the sensitive structures of the neck thanks to the unique properties of the material. Due to its extremely ergonomic features, it is considered a remedy of physical medicine. The use of such a pillow significantly improves the quality of sleep, and thus the quality of life itself.
description.sr: Glavni uzroci bola u ramenima, vratu i glavi su loš položaj i pritisak u vratnom delu kičme. Jastuk je ključ pravilnog položaja pri spavanju. Njegov izbog je od izuzetne važnosti. Anatomski jastuk, osim što daje oslonac vratnoj kičmi, ne pritiska osetljive strukture vrata zahvaljujući unikatnim svojstvima materijala. Zbog svojih izuzetno ergonomskih osobina smatra se lekom fizikalne medicine. Upotreba ovakvog jastuka značajno popravlja kvalitet sna, a samim tim i kvalitet samog života.
